Patient Care Education Research Innovation Get to Know the New UTMB 100+ Locations across Southeast Texas and growing 130+ Years educating health professionals and serving communities 15,000+ Professionals advancing health, education, and research $3.6+ Billion annual operating budget Somerson, Jeremy Anabor-Onoche, Omegie Requena, Lilia Excellence in Patient Care Purpose and passion come together in every patient interaction at UTMB. Here, caregivers learn what exceptional care means and carry it forward—healing patients in our communities and around the world. Get Care Find a Doctor MyChart Login Educating the Future of Health Our students learn by doing. Across five schools, students engage with global opportunities, pioneering research, and a network of peers and alumni who are redefining what’s possible in medicine. Give Today News & Highlights UTMB to enroll first patient in US trial of brain tumor imaging technology August 27, 2026 , 9:53 a.m. by Margaret Battistelli Gardner Investigational agent makes cancerous tissue light up during surgery, potentially helping neurosurgeons distinguish tumors from healthy brain tissue. UTMB neurosurgeon Peter Kan named president of global neurointerventional society August 24, 2026 , 1:08 p.m. by Margaret Battistelli Gardner The Society of NeuroInterventional Surgery brings together specialists in interventional neuroradiology, endovascular neurosurgery, and interventional neurology to advance research, education, advocacy, and standards of care that improve the diagnosis and treatment of diseases affecting the brain, spine, head, and neck. UTMB secures record $10.3 million to expand WIC services across Southeast Texas August 21, 2026 , 10:04 a.m. by Katherine Adams UTMB Health secured a record $10.3 million in USDA funding for its WIC program, nearly $1 million more than last year. The funding will expand nutrition education, breastfeeding support, and healthy food resources across Southeast Texas.
